title: Prune TermAl's 565 registered worktrees under .tmp/ (remove clean ones whose items are closed); decide whether new TermAl worktrees move to .worktrees/
outcome: TermAl keeps only worktrees that serve an open item, an active session, or a recorded retention need. Clean worktrees whose items are closed are removed with `git worktree remove` (never a forced or recursive delete of a dirty tree), with owner consent and path checks, and the removal is recorded. Whether NEW TermAl worktrees go under .worktrees/ instead of .tmp/ is decided by the coordinators and recorded, with its effect on named source roots and tests. Existing live worktrees are never moved.
acceptance: An inventory (git worktree list --porcelain plus each worktree's owner session, item ref and lifecycle, dirty or clean, and active test runs) is recorded in .evidence/ and summarized on this item.

Every removed worktree was clean, its items closed, its owner consented (or the owner session has ended and the coordinator consents), its path was checked to be under C:\github\Personal\TermAl\.tmp\, and no test run was active there. Removal used git worktree remove. Counts and freed space are recorded.
No worktree that holds a frozen input, a named source root of an open claim, retained evidence, or an active run is moved or removed.

The convention decision for new worktrees (.tmp/wt-* as today, or .worktrees/) is recorded with both coordinators' concurrence. If it changes, docs, CLAUDE.md wording and the tests that pin .tmp/wt-* observation are updated in their own reviewed change.
